title: USBridge-KVM 2.0 An open-source IP-KVM with BIOS access over SSH, OCR, and AI support (Crowdfunding)
summary: USBridge-KVM 2.0 is a compact open-source AI-enabled IP-KVM designed for remote management and troubleshooting of servers and PCs, including systems that are unresponsive or have not yet booted. It provides out-of-band BIOS access, remote display and input control, virtual media mounting, and hardware power management. Built around a Radxa Zero 3W single board computer, it also features a 240 240 IPS display, Wi-Fi 6 connectivity, two USB Type-C ports, a Micro HDMI video output (loop), and a MicroSD card slot. It supports hardware UVC video capture up to 1080p and uses Moonlight streaming to achieve 25 50 ms low-latency remote access. One of the most notable features is the BIOS-in-Terminal, which uses offline OCR to convert BIOS and pre-boot screens into text accessible over SSH. title: SONOFF Hydro DUO review A dual-zone BLE and Zigbee water valve tested with eWeLink and Home Assistant
summary: ITEAD has sent us a review sample of the SONOFF Hydro DUO (SWV-ZF2E) dual-channel Zigbee 3.0 and Bluetooth 5 LE smart water valve. The device supports up to 12 custom watering schedules, integrates a water flow meter, and features alert systems for leak risks, low battery, and insufficient water. The device has a maximum Zigbee communication range of 130 meters in open, unobstructed areas. It is primarily designed for the eWeLink app but also works with MQTT-compatible platforms such as Home Assistant. In this review, we will cover everything from unboxing, installation, and getting started with the SONOFF Hydro DUO via Bluetooth LE and Zigbee (through the SONOFF NSPanel Pro Gen2) using the eWeLink app, before switching to Home Assistant and creating an automation system leveraging moisture data from the XIAO Soil Moisture Sensor.
